text:
neel: Postmortem follow-up for INC-4822. Two rollouts overlapped batch priming; blast radius exceeded expectations. Need owners + short deadlines for controls.

tara: agree. minimal set: (1) lint to require owner & ramp metadata on flag PRs, (2) CI check to block rollouts during priming windows, (3) tiny auto-rollback rule + opt-out for Dedicated.

hugo: i'll take the rollback prototype. rule: sustained cohort error delta >=2% OR p95 +200ms for 4m => revert to previous variant + page. add immediate pause if cohort_kv_miss > 10%. ETA 48h.

oncall-sre: add a monthly hygiene job to surface rollouts that started inside known priming windows. pattern: two incidents in 90 days. owner: oncall-sre.

tara: i'll own the PR lint & pipeline check. plan: add `infra/jobs/priming_windows.yaml` as the source of truth and CI job that compares rollout schedule. target: Tue EOD.

neel: great. hugo add tenant opt-out metadata (`auto_rollback_enabled: false`) default on for self-serve.

hugo: yep. will include a short feature-flag to gate the logic during rollout.

ops-bot: task created: RG-1307 "rollout-guardrails" assigned to tara + hugo. CI job `rollout-safety-check` scheduled.

oncall-sre: after rollback prototype, let's run a 7-day shadow on staging replaying priming spikes to check false positives. due in 2 weeks.

tara: also adding a pre-merge lint that rejects flag PRs without `ramp_schedule` and `owner` fields. quick script: `./tools/flag-lint --require-owner --require-ramp`

neel: summary and owners: (rollback prototype: hugo, 2d), (lint + CI blackout check: tara, Tue EOD), (monthly hygiene job: oncall-sre, 7d), (shadow staging run: oncall-sre, 14d). I'll update postmortem tracker.

hugo: opening PR and will link here.

tara: ack.

oncall-sre: ack, scheduling the shadow run.

neel: thanks team. keep links here so I can close the follow-ups.
